contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: True when the page holds no listing.

active_city_or_town.description: Town heading in force on the page, also when printed on an earlier page; null when none is known.

entries.description: One entry per listing, in the order printed.

listing_name.description: Name of the listed business as printed.

entry_is_fragment.description: True when the listing continues from or onto another page.
